sentences.text_target: The morning alarm clock rings very loudly.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ əˈlɑːrm klɑːk rɪŋz ˈvɛri ˈlaʊdli/
sentences.text_native: Le réveil matin sonne très fort.

sentences.text_target: Tom opens his eyes in his warm bed.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm ˈoʊpənz hɪz ˈaɪz ɪn hɪz wɔːrm bɛd/
sentences.text_native: Tom ouvre les yeux dans son lit chaud.

sentences.text_target: He wakes up and sits on the edge.
sentences.phonetic: /hi weɪks ˈʌp ænd sɪts ɑːn ðə ɛdʒ/
sentences.text_native: Il se réveille et s'assied sur le bord du lit.

sentences.text_target: His head feels a little tired today.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz hɛd fiːlz ə ˈlɪtəl ˈtaɪərd təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il se sent un peu fatigué aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He stands up slowly on his feet.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stændz ˈʌp ˈsloʊli ɑːn hɪz fiːt/
sentences.text_native: Il se lève lentement sur ses pieds.

sentences.text_target: His knees bend as he steps onto the floor.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz niːz bɛnd æz hi stɛps ˈɑːntuː ðə flɔːr/
sentences.text_native: Ses genoux se plient lorsqu'il pose le pied sur le sol.

sentences.text_target: He walks to the small bathroom in his house.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks tuː ðə smɔːl ˈbæθruːm ɪn hɪz haʊs/
sentences.text_native: Il marche vers la petite salle de bains de sa maison.

sentences.text_target: Tom looks at his tired face in the mirror.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm lʊks æt hɪz ˈtaɪərd feɪs ɪn ðə ˈmɪrər/
sentences.text_native: Tom regarde son visage fatigué dans le miroir.

sentences.text_target: His hair is messy from a long night of sleep.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz hɛr ɪz ˈmɛsi frʌm ə lɔːŋ naɪt ʌv sliːp/
sentences.text_native: Ses cheveux sont ébouriffés après une longue nuit de sommeil.

sentences.text_target: He takes his toothbrush in his right hand.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks hɪz ˈtuːθbrʌʃ ɪn hɪz raɪt hænd/
sentences.text_native: Il prend sa brosse à dents dans sa main droite.

sentences.text_target: He puts some white toothpaste on the brush.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts sʌm waɪt ˈtuːθpeɪst ɑːn ðə brʌʃ/
sentences.text_native: Il met du dentifrice blanc sur la brosse.

sentences.text_target: He carefully brushes his teeth.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈkɛrfəli ˈbrʌʃɪz hɪz tiːθ/
sentences.text_native: Il se brosse soigneusement les dents.

sentences.text_target: Then he washes his face with water.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hi ˈwɑːʃɪz hɪz feɪs wɪð ˈwɔːtər/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il se lave le visage à l'eau.

sentences.text_target: He uses soft soap for his skin.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈjuːzɪz sɔːft soʊp fɔːr hɪz skɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il utilise un savon doux pour sa peau.

sentences.text_target: Water drops fall from his chin down his neck.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈwɔːtər drɑːps fɔːl frʌm hɪz tʃɪn daʊn hɪz nɛk/
sentences.text_native: Des gouttes d'eau tombent de son menton le long de son cou.

sentences.text_target: He dries his arms and hands with a towel.
sentences.phonetic: /hi draɪz hɪz ɑːrmz ænd hændz wɪð ə ˈtaʊəl/
sentences.text_native: Il se sèche les bras et les mains avec une serviette.

sentences.text_target: Tom rolls his shoulders and stretches his fingers.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm roʊlz hɪz ˈʃoʊldərz ænd ˈstrɛtʃɪz hɪz ˈfɪŋɡərz/
sentences.text_native: Tom fait rouler ses épaules et étire ses doigts.

sentences.text_target: He goes to the kitchen to get some food.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ɡoʊz tuː ðə ˈkɪtʃən tuː ɡɛt sʌm fuːd/
sentences.text_native: Il va dans la cuisine pour manger quelque chose.

sentences.text_target: His stomach feels empty this morning.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈstʌmək fiːlz ˈɛmpti ðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il a l'estomac vide ce matin.

sentences.text_target: He cuts a slice of brown bread for breakfast.
sentences.phonetic: /hi kʌts ə slaɪs ʌv braʊn brɛd fɔːr ˈbrɛkfəst/
sentences.text_native: Il coupe une tranche de pain complet pour le petit-déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: He holds a warm cup of coffee in his hands.
sentences.phonetic: /hi hoʊldz ə wɔːrm kʌp ʌv ˈkɑːfi ɪn hɪz hændz/
sentences.text_native: Il tient une tasse de café chaud dans ses mains.

sentences.text_target: He feels energized after the hot drink.
sentences.phonetic: /hi fiːlz ˈɛnərdʒaɪzd ˈæftər ðə hɑːt drɪŋk/
sentences.text_native: Il se sent revigoré après cette boisson chaude.

sentences.text_target: He puts his shoes on before he leaves.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts hɪz ʃuːz ɑːn bɪˈfɔːr hi liːvz/
sentences.text_native: Il met ses chaussures avant de partir.

sentences.text_target: He opens the front door of his apartment.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈoʊpənz ðə frʌnt dɔːr ʌv hɪz əˈpɑːrtmənt/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre la porte d'entrée de son appartement.

sentences.text_target: Tom walks fast down the street to catch the bus.
sentences.phonetic: /tɑːm wɔːks fæst daʊn ðə striːt tuː kætʃ ðə bʌs/
sentences.text_native: Tom marche d'un bon pas dans la rue pour attraper le bus.

sentences.text_target: He walks quickly through the busy town.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks ˈkwɪkli θruː ðə ˈbɪzi taʊn/
sentences.text_native: Il marche rapidement à travers la ville animée.

sentences.text_target: He arrives at his office building.
sentences.phonetic: /hi əˈraɪvz æt hɪz ˈɔːfɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il arrive à son immeuble de bureaux.

sentences.text_target: He sits down at his large wooden desk.
sentences.phonetic: /hi sɪts daʊn æt hɪz lɑːrdʒ ˈwʊdən dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: Il s'assied à son grand bureau en bois.

sentences.text_target: He gets ready to start his workday.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ɡɛts ˈrɛdi tuː stɑːrt hɪz ˈwɜːrkdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il se prépare à commencer sa journée de travail.

sentences.text_target: He is ready to tackle his professional tasks.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ɪz ˈrɛdi tuː ˈtækəl hɪz prəˈfɛʃənəl tæsks/
sentences.text_native: Il est prêt à s'attaquer à ses tâches professionnelles.
